_doc: Machine-readable cross-machine handoff state. This is the file a Home-PC session reads FIRST to learn what is waiting on it, and what the Work PC is currently doing - without any chat history or founder copy/paste. Written only by the Work-PC Fable QA Director.
_qa_artifact_commit_note: Set to the qa/work-pc commit carrying campaign C001 results (pushed to origin).
_campaign_state_note: C001 checkpointed after 5 production redeploys during the campaign. Both findings verified build-independent across the full range, so no evidence is discarded and no campaign restart is required.
known_coverage_gaps: FLAKY UNDER STUDY: compound chat requests produced a user-facing "Model returned invalid JSON" once, then passed on retry. Recorded FLAKY, not filed as a bug - needs a repeat-run study to establish a real failure rate before classification.
FAILURE CLASS OPEN: ARCHIVED_PARENT_NOT_SURFACED affects up to 24 data-layer join sites; 2 confirmed live (/departments, /people). Remaining ~22 surfaces NOT yet individually tested.

CONTROL-LEVEL INVENTORY INCOMPLETE: 35 routes and ~150 domain server actions are enumerated, but the per-page interactive control inventory (buttons/menus/dropdowns/dialogs) requires the live browser discovery pass. The current denominator of 40 capabilities is therefore a FLOOR, not the true total - it will grow substantially. Coverage % must be read with that in mind.
LIVE QA DASHBOARD — NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: 3 qa-platform capabilities BLOCKED pending the QA-PLATFORM-REALTIME-CONTROL-PLANE Home-PC implementation.

DISTINCT BROWSER PERSONAS UNAVAILABLE (pending investigation): no service-role key to mint synthetic logins. Product-supported paths (public signup, workspace-admin creation, invitePerson() + safe email sink) have NOT yet been investigated - the charter requires that investigation before accepting this as final.
next_action: Home PC priority: BUG-002 (P1, product-wide fabrication class, needs STRUCTURAL zero-ops guard) -> BUG-003 (P2, one-line dashboard filter, cheapest real win) -> BUG-001 (P2, failure class across 24 join sites).

home_pc_instructions._doc: How a Home-PC session consumes this handoff. No chat history required.
home_pc_instructions.1_fetch: git fetch origin qa/work-pc && git show origin/qa/work-pc:qa/HANDOFF_STATE.json
home_pc_instructions.2_read_queue: git show origin/qa/work-pc:qa/BUG_QUEUE.json — work P0 -> P1 -> P2 -> P3 in that order.
home_pc_instructions.3_read_bug_detail: git show origin/qa/work-pc:qa/bugs/<BUG_ID>.md — full repro, six truth checks, evidence, regression path, implementation recommendation.
home_pc_instructions.4_implement: Fix on master. Run the linked regression to confirm it now passes.
home_pc_instructions.5_publish_fix_report: Write qa/home-pc-handoff/fixes/<BUG_ID>.json on the qa/home-pc-handoff branch with: bug_id, fix_commit, implementation_summary, implementation_tests, status='READY_FOR_RETEST', timestamp. Do NOT edit qa/BUG_QUEUE.json - it is Work-PC-owned.
home_pc_instructions.6_never: Never set CLOSED. Only an independent Work-PC retest closes a defect.
